description: Policy for executing deterministic provider ingestion plans through a transaction boundary.
transaction_rules: Every ingestion plan executes inside a single platform transaction.
The worker commits only after every planned upsert succeeds.
The worker rolls back the transaction on any failed upsert.
Transient failures may be retried from the beginning of the plan.
Retry rollback history is recorded separately from the final transaction outcome.
Permanent failures must not be retried.
Upserts must use the idempotency key produced by provider_ingestion_plan.
